description: This header file declares internal API functions for managing records in the Sys Rro Hcxt Object within the BroadWay Runtime System environment. It provides prototypes for functions to get and set record data and value handles.

methods.name: SysRroHcxtGetRecordData
methods.description: Retrieves the record data from the object and places it into a data buffer, updating the data size.

methods.name: SysRroHcxtSetRecordData
methods.description: Sets the record data in the object from the given data buffer and size.

methods.name: SysRroHcxtGetRecordValue
methods.description: Retrieves the record value handle from the object.

methods.name: SysRroHcxtSetRecordValue
methods.description: Sets the record value handle in the object.
